caption: The drawing contains three separate views or details of a sleeveless vest-like garment. The main object at the top is the front view of the garment, which features a light green background with a repeating pattern of small pink and red flowers, green leaves, and brownish stems arranged in a diamond lattice. The edges, seams, and armholes are outlined in black. The garment has buttons running down the center front and flared skirts at the bottom, with additional decorative borders featuring larger floral motifs and circular details. Below, at the left, there is a square detail of the fabric pattern, showing the diamond grid filled with small red flowers and accompanied by a vertical strip with additional floral borders and circular medallions. On the right, a rear view of the garment is displayed, showing the plain back panel in an off-white or beige color, with the floral patterned-green fabric on the sides, and the flared bottom panels with floral detailing visible. The composition is presented on a beige or off-white background, and the outlines are done with fine black lines.
title: Waistcoat
